title: Race two claims for one issued challenge
preconditions: one publisher challenge is durably registered in issued state
steps: prepare two otherwise valid verification requests for the same publisher nonce
release both requests concurrently against the authoritative replay store
invariants: at most one atomic claim succeeds and can create the freshness capability
the losing concurrent request observes consumed state as replay
residual_risk: a valid holder can burn its challenge and must request bounded reissuance
